definition.en: The Production Linked Incentive (PLI) scheme is a government initiative designed to provide financial incentives to companies based on their incremental sales from products manufactured in domestic units.
definition.hi: The Production Linked Incentive (PLI) scheme is a government initiative designed to provide financial incentives to companies based on their incremental sales from products manufactured in domestic units.

importanceInUpsc.en: The PLI scheme is a cornerstone of the 'Make in India' initiative and is critical for understanding India's industrial policy and manufacturing growth. It is frequently tested in UPSC GS-3 under the themes of industrial infrastructure, employment generation, and export competitiveness.
importanceInUpsc.hi: The PLI scheme is a cornerstone of the 'Make in India' initiative and is critical for understanding India's industrial policy and manufacturing growth. It is frequently tested in UPSC GS-3 under the themes of industrial infrastructure, employment generation, and export competitiveness.

learningOutcomes.en: Understand the mechanism of performance-based incentives in manufacturing.
learningOutcomes.hi: Understand the mechanism of performance-based incentives in manufacturing.

learningOutcomes.en: Analyze the impact of PLI on domestic value addition and global supply chain integration.
